thread:
emma-sales: Heads up — NovaBank POC is seeing bursts of 429s when uploading embeddings. Started 07:22 UTC, spikes every few minutes for 20-40s. Customer is worried itll fail demo. Can someone triage?

ryan-eng: Can you paste an example 429 body + any client headers? Also how are they batching?

emma-sales: Client 429: {
  "error": "rate_limited",
  "retry_after": 0.55,
  "trace_id": "nb-5f3c"
}
Client sends: `X-Batch-Size: 192`, `X-Workers: 12`, `X-Client-Version: 1.6.2`, `X-Forwarded-For: 18.205.33.12`
Server log snippet: `429 tenant=novabank route=/v1/embeddings per_route_limit=90 remaining=0 token_budget_remaining=48000`

mila-sre: Quick calc: 192 items * ~40 tokens ~= 7.7k tokens/request. With 6 concurrent inflight that is ~46k tokens -> eats token budget. Two things to confirm: are they sending padded inputs that increase actual token count? And is client retrying aggressively?

zack-support: I pulled tenant quotas: `per_route_rps=90`, `token_budget_per_min=200000`, `burst_window=60s`. Also client app 1.6.2 had a bug where short texts were padded on our SDK to 128 tokens — will check if NovaBank uses our SDK.

ryan-eng: If SDK is padding to 128 tokens per item then 192*128 ~= 24.6k tokens/request, that explains rapid burn. Ask client which SDK and version.

emma-sales: NovaBank says they used the JS SDK v1.6.2 for the ingest. They just upgraded to it.

mila-sre: Confirmed. There's an issue in SDK 1.6.2 where pad_to_multiple_of=128 default got set for embeddings by mistake. That inflates token accounting. Repro on staging: a 10-token input becomes 128 tokens.

ryan-eng: That explains 429 timing. Two immediate actions: 1) ask NovaBank to downgrade or set pad_to_multiple_of=null in client; 2) we can apply a short soft bump so demos don't fail while they roll back. Also file SDK bug fix.

emma-sales: Customer needs the demo in 90 minutes. Can we do a temporary bump? They prefer not to roll back during the demo.

mila-sre: I can approve a 2-hour soft bump: per_route_rps -> 240, token_budget_per_min -> 1.2M. Will monitor. Need ops ticket.

ops-bot: Escalation created: INC-5012. Requested changes: per_route_rps=240, token_budget_per_min=1200000, duration=120m. Requested by mila-sre.

zack-support: Also opened SDK GH issue: redwood/sdk-js#842 — fix default padding behavior and release patch. Added note to POC runbook to check SDK version.

ryan-eng: Client-side mitigation: set `pad_to_multiple_of: null` or downgrade to v1.6.0; reduce batch size to 64 temporarily; cap workers to 8. Sent snippet to NovaBank.

emma-sales: NovaBank accepted the bump and will keep SDK unchanged for demo. They also lowered workers to 6 for the ingest.

mila-sre: Soft bump applied (INC-5012). Monitoring token burn at console.redwood.io/tenants/novabank/usage — will watch trace_ids. If any 429 persists include trace_id and sample request body.

ryan-eng: Well also adjust the billing note — padded tokens count against token budget so we can show them exact token economics post-POC.

zack-support: Post-mortem action items: 1) SDK patch release + notify customers, 2) update POC checklist to verify SDK padding flags, 3) add dashboard alert for sudden per-request token spikes.

emma-sales: Update: 20 min after bump and lowering workers, 429s stopped. Demo completed. Customer asked about long-term options — I'll propose Dedicated for sustained throughput.

mila-sre: Soft bump expired after 2h. Limits reverted. Keep thread open if NovaBank wants permanent quota increase or Dedicated. Closing ops ticket.

ryan-eng: Filing follow-up PR to docs and alerting engineering on the SDK fix. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
